HotelIntro.quote: In waters where time stands still, find a sanctuary that belongs only to you
HotelIntro.body1: Meili Resort is nestled in Semporna, Sabah, Malaysia, adjacent to the world-famous Sipadan Island. Home to one of the richest marine ecosystems on Earth, it is known as a diver's paradise.
HotelIntro.body2: Our resort blends modern comfort with natural beauty. Every room faces the ocean, letting you wake to gentle waves and fall asleep under a canopy of stars. Whether snorkeling, diving, or enjoying leisurely beach time, we fulfill every vision of a perfect holiday.

intro.title1: At the Heart of the Coral Triangle
intro.desc1: Meili Resort sits above the glass-calm waters of Semporna, Malaysia — at 4–5°N, 118–119°E, near the equator. Year-round temperatures of 26–32°C make it an ideal tropical escape.
intro.desc2: Semporna is naturally shielded by the Philippines' Mindanao island and Borneo, placing it in the permanent blind spot of typhoon tracks. In over 100 years, no typhoon has ever struck here — earning it the name "Land Below the Wind."
intro.desc3: The resort sits adjacent to Sipadan Island, the world's top-rated dive site, where sheer underwater cliffs and spectacular marine life draw divers from across the globe.

bajau.title: Guardians of the Sea for Centuries
bajau.desc1: The Bajau, known as the "Sea Nomads," have lived on these waters for generations. Born and raised on the ocean, they free-dive as naturally as they breathe, living in harmony with the coral reef for over a thousand years.
bajau.desc2: They are the most devoted guardians of this sea — and its most unforgettable story. At Meili Resort, you will have the chance to hear this ancient tale of humanity and the ocean.

arrival.subtitle: From your departure city to Meili Resort — seamless, exclusive transfers await
arrival.stage1Body: Board a domestic flight from Kuala Lumpur, Kota Kinabalu, or other cities. Tawau International Airport is just 1.5 hours away.
arrival.stage2Body: Your private hotel vehicle awaits at arrivals. Glide through Semporna's waterfront town as the sea air begins to slow time.
